actions.name: Create Entity
actions.description: Creates a new MemberJunction entity from a fully-formed TableDefinition. Validates authorization then executes the SchemaEngine → RuntimeSchemaManager pipeline. actions.name: Create Mermaid Diagram
actions.description: Generates SVG diagrams from Mermaid text syntax. Supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, class diagrams, state machines, Gantt charts, and more. Mermaid is a text-based diagram tool that converts markdown-like syntax into rich visualizations suitable for reports, documentation, and AI-generated content.

actions.name: Create Record
actions.description: Inserts a NEW record into an MJ entity. Use when the record does not yet exist and you need a generated primary key returned. To modify an existing record, use Update Record. To read existing records, use Get Record (single) or Run View (multiple). Accepts any entity in the MJ metadata; respects entity validation and permissions.

actions.name: Create Scheduled Job
actions.description: Create a new scheduled job with the specified configuration including name, job type, cron expression, and optional parameters

actions.name: Create SVG Chart
actions.description: Generates SVG charts from data using D3. Supports various chart types including bar, line, pie, scatter, and area charts. Designed for AI agents and workflows to create publication-quality visualizations from structured data without writing visualization code.

actions.name: Create SVG Diagram
actions.description: Generates SVG diagrams including flowcharts, org charts, and ER diagrams. Uses dagre for directed graph layouts and d3-hierarchy for tree structures. Designed for AI agents and workflows to create publication-quality diagrams from structured data.

actions.name: Create SVG Infographic
actions.description: Composes multiple SVG visualizations into a single infographic with grid layout, header, and footer. Takes panels from other SVG actions (charts, diagrams, networks, word clouds) and arranges them professionally. Designed for AI agents to create comprehensive visual reports.

actions.name: Create SVG Network
actions.description: Generates SVG network graphs including force-directed layouts, decision trees, and radial networks. Uses d3-force for physics simulations and d3-hierarchy for tree structures. Designed for AI agents and workflows to create publication-quality network visualizations from structured data.

actions.name: Create SVG Sketch Diagram
actions.description: Creates hand-drawn/sketch-style SVG diagrams using Rough.js for informal, whiteboard-style visualizations. Supports flowcharts, org charts, and ER diagrams with configurable roughness and fill styles. Perfect for brainstorming presentations and informal documentation.

actions.name: Create SVG Word Cloud
actions.description: Generates SVG word clouds and tag bars from weighted word lists. Uses d3-cloud for cloud layouts. Designed for AI agents and workflows to create publication-quality text visualizations from data.

actions.name: CSV Parser
actions.description: Parse CSV data into structured JSON with configurable options for headers, delimiters, and data handling

actions.name: Data Mapper
actions.description: Transform data using Nunjucks templates for flexible and powerful data mapping

actions.name: Delete Record
actions.description: Permanently removes a record from an MJ entity. Hard delete — irreversible. For entities that support soft deletes (e.g. setting Status='Archived'), prefer Update Record. To confirm a record exists before deletion, call Get Record first. Respects cascade rules defined in entity metadata.

actions.name: Delete Scheduled Job
actions.description: Delete an existing scheduled job from the system. Will fail if the job has related records that prevent deletion

actions.name: Describe Entity
actions.description: Returns detailed column-level metadata for a MemberJunction entity. Useful for inspecting an entity's current structure before deciding to modify it.

actions.name: Entity Data Quality Report
actions.description: Scans a sample of records for a given entity and returns a data quality report: per-field null rates, distinct value counts, and an overall completeness score (0-1) that weights non-nullable fields 2x. Useful for data stewards triaging bad data. Exercises the `md` (entity introspection) and `rv` (RunView) bridge namespaces.

actions.name: Execute Code
actions.description: Executes JavaScript code in a secure sandboxed environment. Designed for AI agents to generate and run code for data analysis, transformations, and calculations. Supports lodash, date-fns, mathjs, papaparse, uuid, and validator libraries. No filesystem or network access.

actions.name: Explore Database Schema
actions.description: Retrieves comprehensive database schema information using MemberJunction's rich metadata layer. Provides business context, field descriptions, semantic relationships, virtual entities, API settings, and much more beyond raw database schema. Essential for understanding the data model for research purposes.

actions.name: Find Similar Records
actions.description: Finds records in an entity whose text field is similar to a search string. Ranks matches by a blended score (30% containment, 70% normalized Levenshtein) so both typos and long-substring matches rank well. No AI dependency — cheap and deterministic. Validates the target field via metadata before scanning.

actions.name: Get AI Model Cost
actions.description: Gets an AI Model Cost record from the database.

actions.name: Get Entity Details
actions.description: Returns complete field information and sample data for a specific entity. Shows field names, types, descriptions, primary keys, related entities, and a few rows of actual data (3 by default, max 10, long values truncated). Perfect for understanding entity structure before writing SQL queries.

actions.name: Get Entity List
actions.description: Returns a lightweight list of all entities in the system with only name, schema, and description. Perfect for discovering available entities before exploring details. Uses cached metadata - extremely fast with no database queries.

actions.name: Get Record
actions.description: Retrieves a SINGLE record from an MJ entity by primary key. Use when you already know the exact record's primary key. To find records by other criteria (status, name, date range), use Run View with a filter. To execute a stored, named query, use Run Query. Returns the full record with all fields the user has read permission on.

actions.name: Get Records
actions.description: Generic action for retrieving multiple records from any entity with filtering and sorting capabilities. Supports SQL WHERE clause filters, ORDER BY sorting, and result limits.

actions.name: Get Scheduled Job Statistics
actions.description: Retrieve execution statistics for scheduled jobs including total runs, success/failure counts, success rate, and average duration

actions.name: JSON Transform
actions.description: Transform JSON data using JSONPath or JMESPath expressions for flexible data manipulation

actions.name: List My Entities
actions.description: Returns a list of all MemberJunction entities created by the current user via the Database Designer (based on MJ:UDT:Owner EntitySettings provenance records).

actions.name: Modify Entity
actions.description: Applies ALTER TABLE changes to an existing MemberJunction entity based on a desired TableDefinition. Diffs the desired state against the current table, generates ALTER SQL, and executes the pipeline.

actions.name: Query Scheduled Jobs
actions.description: Query scheduled jobs based on filter criteria including Status, JobTypeID, IsActive flag, and creation date ranges

actions.name: Run Ad-hoc Query
actions.description: Executes a read-only SQL SELECT query for ad-hoc purposes with security validation. Supports {{query:"CategoryPath/QueryName"}} composition macros — the composition engine resolves these into CTEs before execution, enabling reuse of saved queries. Ensures SELECT-only operations, prevents dangerous SQL operations, enforces timeouts, and logs all queries for audit trail.

actions.name: Run External Change Detection
actions.description: Executes the External Change Detection process to identify changes in data that bypassed MemberJunction.

actions.name: Run Integration Sync
actions.description: Triggers a data sync for a Company Integration. Pulls or pushes records according to entity maps, field maps, and watermarks configured for the integration.

actions.name: Run Record Process
actions.description: Runs a MJ: Record Processes definition against a runtime scope (selected records, a view, a list, or a filter), optionally as a dry-run. Thin wrapper over the RecordProcessExecutor engine — the agent / workflow / low-code surface for the same bulk-update capability the Record Process Runner UX drives. For WorkType=FieldRules, a dry-run computes the exact per-record field diff without writing.

actions.name: Run Stored Query
actions.description: Executes a stored query by ID or name, with optional parameters. Uses the full query pipeline including composition resolution, Nunjucks templating, caching, and audit logging. Preferred over ad-hoc SQL when a matching stored query exists.

actions.name: Scheduled Geocoding
actions.description: Maintenance action that finds records missing geocodes, retries failed geocoding attempts, and cleans up orphaned RecordGeoCode rows. Processes all pending records in parallel batches with cache invalidation. Designed to run on a schedule as a safety net for records that bypass BaseEntity.Save() (bulk SQL imports, direct DB operations).

actions.name: Scoped Search
actions.description: Scope-aware universal search for AI agents. Enforces the calling agent's SearchScopeAccess ('All' | 'Assigned' | 'None') and resolves the requested scope against the agent's AIAgentSearchScope rows. Supports agent-invoked pre-rendered query templates, per-provider query transforms, multi-scope RRF fusion, and (optional) re-ranking. Returns ranked, scored, and enriched results in the same shape as the universal Search action.

actions.name: Search
actions.description: Executes a universal search across the organization's knowledge base using vector similarity, full-text, and entity LIKE-based search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Returns ranked, scored, and enriched results. Designed for AI agents, MCP connectors, A2A connectors, and workflow orchestration.

actions.name: Search Query Catalog
actions.description: Searches the saved query catalog using vector-based semantic search. Takes a natural language description of what data is needed and returns ranked matching queries with similarity scores. Use this to find existing queries before writing ad-hoc SQL.

actions.name: Update Record
actions.description: Modifies an EXISTING record in an MJ entity. Use when the record already exists and you know its primary key. To insert a new record, use Create Record. To remove a record, use Delete Record. Only the supplied fields are changed; all other fields are preserved. Respects entity validation, permissions, and audit trails (Record Changes).

actions.name: Update Scheduled Job
actions.description: Update an existing scheduled job. Only provided fields will be updated; omitted fields remain unchanged

actions.name: Validate Entity Schema
actions.description: Validates a TableDefinition against all Database Designer pre-creation checks (blocked schemas, reserved column names, naming conflicts). Returns a ValidationResult with Valid, Errors, and Warnings. Call this before CreateEntity to surface problems at the UI review step rather than mid-pipeline.

actions.name: Write Entity Field(s)
actions.description: Writes one or more fields onto a SINGLE entity record — either updating an existing record (identified by its PrimaryKey) or creating a new one (when CreateIfMissing=true and no PrimaryKey is supplied). A reusable write primitive for Flow Agents and as the terminal write-back step of a Feature Pipeline: give it the target entity, an optional primary key, and a field map, and it loads-or-creates, sets the fields, and saves. Respects entity validation, permissions, and audit trails (Record Changes). To always insert use Create Record; to read use Get Record / Run View.

actions.name: XML Parser
actions.description: Parse XML data and extract values using XPath expressions with namespace support

actions.name: Autotag and Vectorize Content
actions.description: Runs MJ's Content Autotagging and/or Vector Embedding pipeline over Content Items. Either step can be toggled independently via the Autotag and Vectorize boolean parameters (both default ON). Operates on the Content Items entity by default. For vectorizing OTHER entities (not Content Items), use Vectorize Entity instead.

actions.name: Betty
actions.description: Query your organization's knowledge base assistant for information about company policies, procedures, documentation, and institutional knowledge. Betty provides context-aware responses with optional reference links to supporting materials.

actions.name: Computer Use
actions.description: Drives a web browser via LLM reasoning over screenshots to accomplish a natural-language goal. Uses a vision-to-action loop: captures screenshots, sends them to a controller LLM that plans browser actions (click, type, navigate, scroll), executes those actions via Playwright, and evaluates progress with a judge LLM. Supports per-domain authentication, domain allow/block lists, and configurable step limits.

actions.name: Create Runtime Action
actions.description: Creates a new Action record with Type='Runtime'. Validates the supplied RuntimeActionConfiguration, persists the Action row (CodeApprovalStatus='Pending'), and creates companion ActionParam + ActionResultCode rows from the input/output/resultCodes payloads. The created action is NOT activated until a human approves it.

actions.name: Execute Agent
actions.description: Executes a top-level AI Agent by name or ID using the framework's AgentRunner. Only invokable for agents with ExposeAsAction=true. Returns the AgentRunID, final payload, and full AgentResult. Sub-agents (ParentID set) cannot be invoked through this action — run the parent agent instead.

actions.name: Execute AI Prompt
actions.description: Execute MemberJunction AI prompts with variable substitution and model overrides

actions.name: Find Candidate Actions
actions.description: Finds the most relevant actions for a given task using semantic search with embeddings. Returns top N most similar actions based on task description. Used by Planning Designer Agent to discover relevant actions without searching through hundreds of options.

actions.name: Find Candidate Agents
actions.description: Finds the best-matching AI agents for a given task using embedding-based semantic search. Returns agents ranked by similarity score.

actions.name: Generate Image
actions.description: Generates or edits images using AI image generation models (OpenAI GPT-4o Image, Google Nano Banana Pro, Black Forest Labs FLUX). Supports text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing/transformation when SourceImage is provided. Configurable size, quality, style, and output format. Returns images as base64 or URLs.

actions.name: Load Agent Spec
actions.description: Loads the complete AgentSpec structure for an existing agent by ID. Returns full agent specification including all nested structures: Actions, SubAgents, Prompts, Steps, and Paths. Used by Agent Manager for modification workflow.

actions.name: Run Cluster Analysis
actions.description: Clusters an entity's embedding vectors (KMeans or DBSCAN), projects them to a 2D/3D layout via UMAP (PCA fallback), optionally names clusters with an LLM, and — when a PersistAs name is supplied — saves the result as an MJ: Cluster Analysis record. Thin wrapper over the framework-agnostic ClusteringEngine.

actions.name: Summarize Entity Records
actions.description: Queries a sample of records from the specified entity, passes them to an AI prompt, and returns a structured summary with key themes and suggested follow-up questions. Exercises the `rv` + `ai` bridge namespaces — the most common composition agents reach for.

actions.name: Test Runtime Action
actions.description: Runs a Runtime action against declared test cases. Accepts either (ActionID/ActionName) for an existing Action record or (Code + Configuration) for a freshly-generated, not-yet-persisted Runtime action. Each case runs through ActionEngine.RunAction so the full timeout / bridge / approval path is exercised. Returns per-case pass/fail plus AllPassed / PassedCount / FailedCount for the whole batch.

actions.name: Vectorize Entity
actions.description: Creates and stores vector embeddings for records in one or more MJ entities. Use to enable semantic search over arbitrary entity data. For Content Items specifically, prefer Autotag and Vectorize Content which also assigns tags. Vectors are stored per the entity's configured vector database and embedding model.

actions.name: Add View Results To List
actions.description: Append a User View's current results to an existing List. Always additive — never removes existing members. Dedupes silently.

actions.name: Bulk Update List Item Status
actions.description: Bulk-update the Status field on MJ: List Detail rows for a given list. NewStatus must match the MJ: List Detail Status check constraint (Active / Complete / Disabled / Error / Other / Pending / Rejected).

actions.name: Compose Lists
actions.description: Compose multiple List or View sources into a delta via a set-op (union / intersection / difference). Preview-only by default; supplying a Target projects the result into that list, which can trigger the drop-guard.

actions.name: Invite To List
actions.description: Issue a pending-email invitation to share a List. Returns a generated token + expiry. Caller is expected to deliver an accept link to the recipient.

actions.name: Materialize List From View
actions.description: Create a new MJ List from a User View. Thin wrapper around ListOperations.MaterializeFromView. Captures lineage when RememberLineage=true. Cannot produce drops (target is new).

actions.name: Move List Members
actions.description: Move (or copy) a set of records from one list to another. Move mode also removes the records from the source list — requires ConfirmDrops=true to actually delete. Copy mode skips the removal step.

actions.name: Refresh List From Source
actions.description: Refresh an existing lineage-bearing List against its captured source view (Additive or Sync mode). Sync-mode refreshes that would remove records require ConfirmDrops=true; otherwise rejected with DROP_NOT_CONFIRMED.

actions.name: Resolve Audience
actions.description: Resolve an AudienceSource (list / view / ad-hoc filter) to its current record IDs. Read-only — never mutates. Useful for previewing how many records a campaign would hit before sending.

actions.name: Revoke List Invitation
actions.description: Revoke a pending List invitation before it has been accepted. Returns INVITATION_ALREADY_USED if the invitation was already consumed — callers should use Unshare List against the resulting permission row in that case.

actions.name: Share List
actions.description: Grant a direct share on a List to a user or role. Idempotent at the (list, target) pair. Writes to ResourcePermission; emits a share-notification when sharing with a user.

actions.name: Unshare List
actions.description: Revoke a previously-granted List permission. Soft-revokes (sets Status='Revoked' on ResourcePermission) so the audit trail remains intact.

actions.name: Add Document Content
actions.description: Appends content to an in-progress document created by Create Document. Each call creates a new addressable section. Operations include: heading, paragraph, table, list, image, hr, pageBreak, sheet (Excel), formula (Excel).

actions.name: Create Document
actions.description: Creates a new in-progress document (PDF, DOCX, or XLSX) and returns a handle for incremental building. Use with Add Document Content, Preview Document, Modify Document Section, and Finalize Document to build documents piece by piece across multiple turns.

actions.name: Excel Reader
actions.description: Read Excel files and convert to JSON with support for specific sheets and ranges

actions.name: File Compress
actions.description: Compress or decompress files using ZIP format with configurable compression levels

actions.name: File Storage: Check Directory Exists
actions.description: Check if a directory exists in a storage provider.

actions.name: File Storage: Check Object Exists
actions.description: Check if a file object exists in a storage provider.

actions.name: File Storage: Copy Object
actions.description: Copy a file object within a storage provider from one location to another.

actions.name: File Storage: Create Directory
actions.description: Create a directory in a storage provider.

actions.name: File Storage: Delete Directory
actions.description: Delete a directory from a storage provider. Optionally delete recursively.

actions.name: File Storage: Delete Object
actions.description: Delete a file object from a storage provider.

actions.name: File Storage: Get Download URL
actions.description: Generate a pre-authenticated download URL for a file. The URL can be used to download the file without additional authentication.

actions.name: File Storage: Get File Content
actions.description: Smart file content retrieval with automatic extraction based on file type. Returns LLM-ready content: plain text for documents (PDF/Word/Excel extraction), base64 for images, decoded text for text formats. Optimized for AI agent consumption.

actions.name: File Storage: Get Object
actions.description: Download file content from a storage provider. Returns the file content as base64-encoded data.

actions.name: File Storage: Get Object Metadata
actions.description: Retrieve metadata about a file object in a storage provider. Returns size, content type, last modified date, and other properties.

actions.name: File Storage: Get Upload URL
actions.description: Generate a pre-authenticated upload URL for a file. The URL can be used to upload a file without additional authentication.

actions.name: File Storage: List Objects
actions.description: List files and directories in a storage provider path. Active providers: Azure Blob Storage, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box.com, SharePoint Storage. Inactive: AWS S3 Storage, Google Cloud Storage.

actions.name: File Storage: Move Object
actions.description: Move or rename a file object within a storage provider.

actions.name: Finalize Document
actions.description: Renders an in-progress document to its final binary format, saves to MJ Storage, and outputs FileOutput for automatic artifact creation. The document handle is disposed after finalization.

actions.name: Gamma Generate Presentation
actions.description: Generates presentations, documents, or social media posts using Gamma's AI-powered Generations API. Creates professional slides from text input with customizable themes, images, and export formats.

actions.name: List Storage Providers
actions.description: Retrieves a list of active file storage providers configured in the system. Returns provider names, descriptions, and search support status. Useful for agents to discover available storage before searching or accessing files.

actions.name: Modify Document Section
actions.description: Replaces or removes a previously-added section in an in-progress document. Section IDs are returned by Add Document Content and Preview Document.

actions.name: PDF Extractor
actions.description: Extract text, metadata, and pages from PDF files

actions.name: Preview Document
actions.description: Returns a summary of an in-progress document's current state: section count, per-section operation counts and content summaries. Use to check what has been built before adding more or finalizing.

actions.name: Search Storage Files
actions.description: Searches for files across configured storage providers using native search APIs. Supports Google Drive, SharePoint, Dropbox, and Box with content search, file type filtering, date ranges, and path restrictions.

actions.name: Send Single Message
actions.description: Sends one outbound message (email, SMS, push notification, etc.) via the MJ Communication Framework. The actual channel is determined by the Provider + MessageType parameters — this single action handles all message types the configured provider supports. For bulk send, use a Run View to gather recipients then loop, or use a provider-specific bulk action if available.

actions.name: Send To Audience
actions.description: Send a single message template to every record resolved from an AudienceSource. Wraps SendToAudience() in @memberjunction/communication-engine. Records missing the recipient field are skipped and surfaced in SkippedRecords output.

actions.name: Slack Webhook
actions.description: Send messages to Slack channels via incoming webhooks with rich formatting support

actions.name: Teams Webhook
actions.description: Send messages to Microsoft Teams channels via incoming webhooks with card formatting

actions.name: Weekly Entity Digest
actions.description: Composes a weekly markdown digest from activity across one or more entities, then emails it via the Send Single Message action. Exercises every major bridge namespace: metadata-bounded entity queries (rv), standard library helpers (libs), AI prompt rendering (ai), and downstream action invocation (actions). Supports dryRun=true to return the markdown without sending.

actions.name: API Rate Limiter
actions.description: Add rate limiting to any API endpoint with automatic retry and backoff

actions.name: Execute MCP Tool
actions.description: Executes a tool on an MCP server. Connects to the server if not already connected, calls the specified tool with provided arguments, and returns the result. This is the primary action for invoking external tool capabilities through MCP.

actions.name: GraphQL Query
actions.description: Execute GraphQL queries and mutations with variable support

actions.name: HTTP Request
actions.description: Make HTTP requests with full control over headers, authentication, and request options

actions.name: List MCP Tools
actions.description: Retrieves the list of available tools from an MCP server connection. Returns tool names, descriptions, and input schemas for each tool. Use this action for discovery to understand what tools are available on a server before executing them.

actions.name: OAuth Flow
actions.description: Handle OAuth 2.0 authentication flows including authorization code and client credentials

actions.name: Sync MCP Tools
actions.description: Synchronizes tools from an MCP server to the local database. Discovers all available tools, adds new ones, updates existing tool definitions, and marks tools that are no longer available as deprecated. Use this action to keep the local tool catalog up to date with the server.

actions.name: Test MCP Connection
actions.description: Tests connectivity to an MCP server and retrieves server information including name, version, capabilities, and connection latency. Use this action to verify an MCP server is reachable and responding correctly before attempting to execute tools.

actions.name: Google Custom Search
actions.description: Performs web search using Google's Custom Search JSON API with advanced filtering and structured results. Provides high-quality search results with support for site filtering, date restrictions, file type filtering, and more.

actions.name: Perplexity Search
actions.description: Performs AI-powered web search using Perplexity's Search API. Returns comprehensive search results with citations, related questions, and optional images. Supports advanced filtering by domain and recency.

actions.name: URL Link Validator
actions.description: Validates URLs by checking accessibility, response codes, and performing health checks with detailed status information

actions.name: URL Metadata Extractor
actions.description: Extracts comprehensive metadata from web pages including OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, Schema.org structured data, and standard HTML meta tags

actions.name: Web Page Content
actions.description: Fetches the content of a specific URL and converts it to text/markdown/JSON. Use when you already have a URL (from Web Search, a user-supplied link, or an API endpoint) and need its content. Handles HTML, PDF, DOCX, XML, CSV, and JSON automatically with format detection.

actions.name: Web Search
actions.description: Searches the open web via DuckDuckGo and returns a ranked list of result URLs with titles and snippets. Use when you need to discover relevant pages but do not yet know specific URLs. To fetch the actual content of a known URL, use Web Page Content. Rate-limited; supports queueing.

actions.name: Conditional
actions.description: Execute different actions based on a condition evaluation

actions.name: Delay
actions.description: Add fixed or random delays to workflows for timing control

actions.name: Loop
actions.description: Iterate over collections executing actions for each item with parallel processing support

actions.name: Parallel Execute
actions.description: Execute multiple actions in parallel with configurable concurrency and completion modes

actions.name: Retry
actions.description: Retry failed actions with exponential backoff and configurable retry conditions

actions.name: Promote ML Model
actions.description: Transitions an ML Model through its lifecycle (Validated / Published / Archived). Enforces the leakage sign-off gate — a model flagged for possible target leakage cannot be promoted unless SignOff=true. Lifecycle-only: never edits the model's metrics or artifact, only its Status.

actions.name: Run Experiment Session
actions.description: Executes an approved modeling plan as an experiment session — running its proposed experiments in waves to completion or until the budget bound, maintaining a leaderboard. Outputs the session id, the best (winning) model id, the final leaderboard, and why the session stopped.

actions.name: Schedule Model Scoring
actions.description: Binds a trained ML Model to write its prediction into a target entity column on a recurring schedule (e.g. monthly). Creates a scheduled Record Process that scores the rows selected by a filter and writes the prediction back into the chosen column on its cadence. Outputs the new Record Process id and the cron expression.

actions.name: Score Record Set
actions.description: Scores a set of records with a trained ML Model. The scope selects records (explicit ids / a saved view / a list / an entity+filter / a single record). Returns the scored count and either the ephemeral predictions or confirmation that scores were written back to the target.

actions.name: Train ML Model
actions.description: Trains a predictive model from an ML Training Pipeline definition. Carves a locked holdout, trains via the sidecar, persists an immutable Draft ML Model, and flags single-feature dominance (possible target leakage). Outputs the new model id, its honest holdout metrics, and whether it was leakage-flagged.

actions.name: Download Signed Document
actions.description: Download the executed/signed document for a completed signature request and record it as a Signed-role document. Returns the document as base64.

actions.name: Get Signature Status
actions.description: Poll the provider for the current envelope status of a signature request and persist it (including recipient statuses).

actions.name: Send Document for Signature
actions.description: Send one or more documents through a configured signature account/provider (e.g. DocuSign) and create the envelope lifecycle record. Documents are supplied as base64. Optionally links to an originating record (EntityID/RecordID) and an Artifact for provenance.

actions.name: Void Signature Request
actions.description: Void/cancel an in-flight signature request with a reason.

actions.name: Activate Interactive Form Version
actions.description: Promote a Pending EntityFormOverride to Active. Atomically demotes any sibling Active override at the same scope target to Inactive (and its Component). The Pending Override is the one the agent just produced via Modify; activating it makes it the live form. Old Component rows persist forever as immutable history — revertible via 'Revert Interactive Form'.

actions.name: Assign User Roles
actions.description: Assigns one or more roles to a user by creating UserRole associations. Accepts either a single role name (RoleName) or an array of role names (RoleNames).

actions.name: Business Days Calculator
actions.description: Calculates business days between dates, accounting for weekends and holidays. Can add/subtract business days from a date

actions.name: Calculate Array Statistics
actions.description: Takes an array of numbers and returns summary statistics: count, min, max, sum, mean, median, stdDev, variance, and outliers detected via n-sigma distance from the mean. Pure compute — runs entirely inside the sandbox, no MJ metadata or entity access required. Useful as a building block for numeric summarization inside agent workflows, and as a smoke test for the Runtime Actions pipeline.

actions.name: Calculate Expression
actions.description: Evaluates mathematical expressions supporting basic arithmetic, parentheses, and common math functions

actions.name: Census Data Lookup
actions.description: Retrieves US Census demographic and economic data for a given ZIP code or city/state location

actions.name: Color Converter
actions.description: Converts colors between different formats (HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV) and provides color analysis

actions.name: Create Employee
actions.description: Creates a new employee record in the MemberJunction system

actions.name: Create Interactive Form
actions.description: Persists a net-new AI-authored or human-authored runtime form. Lints the supplied ComponentSpec (must declare componentRole='form'), inserts a Component row v1.0.0 with the spec, and creates an EntityFormOverride row that activates the form for the calling user. Returns ALREADY_EXISTS if the user already has an Active override for this entity — agents should call 'Modify Interactive Form' in that case. Scope is always clamped to 'User' regardless of any args — the action never writes Global or Role overrides.

actions.name: Create User
actions.description: Creates a new user in the MemberJunction system with validation and optional employee linking

actions.name: Execute Scheduled Job Now
actions.description: Run a scheduled job immediately, bypassing its cron schedule. Executes through the scheduling engine — lock acquisition, the job's plugin, the run record, statistics and notifications — and reports the job's actual outcome. Set Wait=false to start it and return without waiting.

actions.name: Geocode Address
actions.description: Converts a free-form address string into structured address components (street, city, state, postal code, country) and geographic coordinates using the Google Geocoding API.

actions.name: Get Active Form For Entity
actions.description: Read-only action returning the currently-resolved interactive-form override (if any) for the (entity, requesting user) pair plus the full list of applicable variants. Returns null Active + empty Variants when no override exists. Used by the Form Builder agent to decide between Create (no override exists) and Modify (an override already exists).

actions.name: Get Default Form Scaffold For Entity
actions.description: Read-only action that produces a working form-role ComponentSpec scaffolded from an entity's CodeGen metadata (Category, GeneratedFormSectionType, Sequence, FK relationships, value lists, EntitySetting icons). Mirrors the default Angular form layout. Agents call this first when authoring a net-new form, then modify the scaffold per user requirements — far fewer lint failures than writing JSX from scratch.

actions.name: Get Entity Schema For Form
actions.description: Read-only action consumed by the Form Builder agent. Returns the curated form-relevant schema for an entity: field list with normalised types (string | number | boolean | datetime | enum | foreign-key), FK references resolved to {entity, displayField}, value-list fields annotated with allowedValues, and audit / virtual / computed fields stripped. The shape matches the CuratedFormSchema type in @memberjunction/interactive-component-types/forms.

actions.name: Get Stock Price
actions.description: Looks up the current price and trading data for a single publicly-traded stock by ticker symbol. US/major-exchange tickers only. Returns the latest price snapshot.

actions.name: Get Weather
actions.description: Looks up the current weather for a single location, either by city name or by latitude/longitude. Returns current conditions and temperature for a single point in time.

actions.name: IP Geolocation
actions.description: Retrieves geolocation information for an IP address including location, timezone, ISP, and privacy indicators

actions.name: Modify Interactive Form
actions.description: Modify an existing interactive-form override. Routes off the source Override's status (not the underlying Component). Behavior is driven by the optional VersionBumpKind input: 'in-place' (default for Pending sources) overwrites the Pending Component row with no new version; 'patch'/'minor'/'major' snapshot a new Pending Component + sibling Override using the bumped version. Pending sources with a bump demote the prior Pending to Inactive (preserves rollback history). Active sources reject 'in-place' (would corrupt the live row) and default to 'minor'. Inactive sources reject 'in-place' (use Revert to re-activate first) but accept patch/minor/major as a branch-from-historical operation — default 'patch'; the Inactive source row is left untouched. Scope is preserved from the existing override.

actions.name: Password Strength
actions.description: Check password strength and generate secure passwords using zxcvbn analysis

actions.name: Postal Code Lookup
actions.description: Looks up city, state, country, and geographic coordinates from a postal code using the Google Geocoding API. Supports international postal codes.

actions.name: QR Code
actions.description: Generates and reads QR codes with customizable options for size, error correction, and styling

actions.name: Reverse Geocode
actions.description: Converts geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude) into a structured address using the Google Geocoding API. Useful for finding the address at a known location.

actions.name: Revert Interactive Form
actions.description: Re-point an Active EntityFormOverride at an older Component version in the same Name lineage. Pure UPDATE on the override row; no new Components or Overrides are created. Use to roll back to a prior working form when a recent change misbehaves. Old Component rows are never deleted, so revert is fully reversible by reverting again to the original version.

actions.name: Summarize Content
actions.description: Creates a concise summary of content with citations to source material. Can work with either a URL (fetch + summarize) or pre-fetched content. Supports configurable summary length, optional citations with quotes and links, focus instructions for domain-specific summarization, and multiple output formats (paragraph, bullets, hybrid).

actions.name: Text Analyzer
actions.description: Analyzes text content providing statistics, readability scores, and word frequency analysis

actions.name: Unit Converter
actions.description: Converts values between different units of measurement including length, weight, temperature, volume, area, speed, and time

actions.name: Validate Address
actions.description: Validates and standardizes an address using the Google Address Validation API. Returns corrected address fields, deliverability verdict, geographic coordinates, and USPS data for US addresses. Requires the Address Validation API to be enabled in Google Cloud.

actions.name: Validate Email Unique
actions.description: Validates that an email address is not already in use by another user in the system
